libm 0.2.16: complete unchanged legal and attribution source-header supplement
Release revision: dfd2203a4d6110820ad7bb65cafe1bf331a03a3d; repository path: libm.
Coverage: 69 source files total: 53 copyright/permission-header files and 16 additional SPDX/origin-attribution files.
All 146 release source .rs files were scanned and matched exact upstream Git blobs.
Quoted headers are unchanged source bytes, retaining copyright, permission, disclaimers, SPDX identifiers, origin, conversion, optimization and port credits.
Separable algorithm documentation, Rust attributes, imports and executable code are excluded.
Preserve the upstream root LICENSE.txt separately. This is not an upstream NOTICE, new grant or legal clearance.
Byte ranges are zero-based and half-open; line ranges are one-based and inclusive.
